description: Human golden candidate H2 (img/H2_bearish_cisd_4h_fvg.png: a trader's bearish CISD inside a 4H FVG, short position). Candles digitised: price = 1000 - pixel row. The trader's CISD line is at the OPEN of the first candle of the up-close series (bar 10, row 183) that made the highest up-close high; the highest high overall (bar 8's wick) is a down-close candle and is not used. Confirmed by the close of bar 12 below the line; the trade is entered at bar 13's open. CISD-R reproduces origin, L and the confirming bar.
